headline: SANDFIRE BLACK BUTTE: LOWRY DEPOSIT EXTENDS MONTANA COPPER TO 12-YEAR LIFE — 14.3MT AT 2.6% CU, PRE-TAX NPV $213M
snippet: Sandfire Resources America released an updated PFS for the Black Butte Copper Project in Meagher County, Montana on July 9 — adding the adjacent Lowry deposit to the mine plan and increasing combined Probable Mineral Reserves to 14.3 million tonnes grading 2.6% copper for 370,000 tonnes of contained metal, extending the mine life to 12 years from the previous 8-year Johnny Lee-only scenario. The study carries a pre-tax NPV8% of US$213 million (IRR 15.6%) and a post-tax NPV8% of US$126 million; with Johnny Lee hosting 9.5 million tonnes at 2.9% copper, Black Butte is now the highest-grade undeveloped underground copper project in the United States — a position that becomes increasingly strategic as domestic copper supply shortfalls intensify under electrification demand.

headline: NEXGOLD EXPANDS GOLDBORO TO 40,000M AFTER 12.06 G/T OVER 6M — NOVA SCOTIA RC INFILL 62% COMPLETE, GRADES HOLDING (TSXV:NEXG)
snippet: NexGold Mining (TSXV: NEXG) announced July 9 that continued strength in its Reverse Circulation infill program at Goldboro Gold Project in Nova Scotia has triggered a 33% program expansion — from approximately 30,000 metres to 40,000 metres — with the expanded program 62% complete and running into Q4 2026; hole RC-26-147 returned 6 metres at 12.06 g/t Au (including 1m at 67.41 g/t) while RC-26-102 cut 18 metres at 3.84 g/t Au. Shares rose 3.4% to C$1.22 on the news; mid-program expansion decisions are a reliable signal that infill results are coming in meaningfully better than the resource model — a development that should translate directly into higher-confidence ounces in the next updated resource estimate.

headline: ORLA'S MUSSELWHITE: 6.38 G/T GOLD IN Q2, 88,265 OZ, $451M CASH — EQUINOX MERGER VOTE JULY 22 WITH BALANCE SHEET IN ORDER (TSX:OLA)
snippet: Orla Mining (TSX: OLA) reported July 9 that the Musselwhite underground mine in Ontario delivered 67,077 ounces at a head grade of 6.38 g/t Au in Q2 2026 — well above reserve grade — driving combined Q2 gold production of 88,265 ounces, a $451 million cash position, and US$318.7 million in negative net debt, with the company on track for full-year guidance of 340,000–360,000 ounces. With shareholders of both companies meeting July 22 to vote on the all-share merger with Equinox Gold that creates a 1 million oz/year producer, Orla's Q2 data arriving with a strong balance sheet and above-plan Musselwhite grades lands exactly where management needs it — confirming the quality of the asset Equinox shareholders are voting to acquire.

headline: CHINA'S PBOC ADDS 14.93T GOLD IN JUNE — 20TH CONSECUTIVE MONTH BUYING, BIGGEST PURCHASE SINCE 2023, RESERVES HIT 2,346 TONNES
snippet: The People's Bank of China added 14.93 tonnes of gold to official reserves in June 2026 — the largest single-month purchase since 2023 and the 20th consecutive month of buying — lifting total reserves to 75.44 million ounces (approximately 2,346 tonnes), in data released July 7. The divergence is now a defining structural tension in the gold market: the PBOC added nearly 15 tonnes during gold's worst quarterly decline in thirteen years, confirming that Beijing's accumulation is price-insensitive and driven by de-dollarisation rather than momentum — precisely the kind of demand floor that prevents gold from repricing to levels implied by Western rate-hike expectations and explains why the metal has not sustained breaks below $4,000 despite back-to-back weeks of selling pressure.

headline: ALL 18 RARE EARTHS UP IN JULY: GERMANIUM +27.8%, DYSPROSIUM +25.4%, TERBIUM +21.6% — FIRST BROAD-BASED RALLY OF 2026
snippet: Every one of the 18 rare earth elements tracked advanced in July 2026 — germanium leading at +27.8%, dysprosium surging 25.4% to $261.63/kg (its largest single-month move of the year), and terbium rising 21.6% to $1,179.54/kg, clearing its previous 2026 April high — for an average basket gain of 16.7%, the first genuinely broad-based advance of the year after a volatile H1. The breadth of the advance is more telling than the magnitude: when light, medium, and heavy rare earths move together simultaneously, it typically signals a demand-side catalyst rather than a single supply disruption — pointing to EV and wind turbine procurement reopening after a Q1-Q2 inventory destocking pause, with China's 92%+ share of NdPr refining and 98–99% of separated heavy rare earth production the structural supply constraint underneath all of it.

headline: CHILE LITHIUM EXPORTS NEARLY TRIPLE IN H1 2026 — $3.2B IN VALUE AS PRICES HOLD ELEVATED AND ASIAN DEMAND STAYS FIRM
snippet: Chile's lithium export revenues nearly tripled in the first half of 2026 compared to the prior-year period — reaching $3.2 billion from January through June on higher lithium carbonate prices and persistent Asian buyer demand — as South America's largest lithium producer captured material economic rent during the structural price recovery that carried spot carbonate from the CNY 151,750/tonne trough toward CNY 165,000/tonne. The value surge is significant context for juniors and project developers: strong Chilean export data at current prices de-risks project financing conversations by confirming end-buyer demand integrity and demonstrating that lithium demand has not weakened despite a more cautious EV market in North America and Europe.

headline: IVANHOE KAMOA-KAKULA: 64,328T COPPER IN Q2 — 30% MINING RATE INCREASE TO 8.5 MTPA LAUNCHING IN H2 2026 (TSX:IVN)
snippet: Ivanhoe Mines (TSX: IVN) reported July 9 that the Kamoa-Kakula Copper Mining Complex in the DRC produced 64,328 tonnes of copper in Q2 2026, with 2026 full-year guidance maintained at 290,000–330,000 tonnes, and a 30% mining rate increase to approximately 8.5 million tonnes per annum beginning in H2 expected to drive the production step-change that underpins the upper end of that range. For copper market watchers, Kamoa-Kakula is the most important single mine globally: it is the world's highest-grade large-scale copper operation and its H2 2026 ramp, if executed, would constitute one of the largest incremental copper production additions from any single site this year — material context for understanding why structural copper supply tightness persists even as near-term macro uncertainty has weighed on prices.

headline: EMERITA EL CURA VMS: 3.9M AT 3.8% CU, 2.81 G/T AU, 71 G/T AG — ANDALUCIAN AAU EXPLOITATION PERMIT CONSULTATION COMPLETE (TSXV:EMO)
source_name: Investing News Network / Emerita Resources Corp.
snippet: Emerita Resources (TSXV: EMO) released July 9 new assay results from the El Cura VMS deposit at its Iberian Belt West project in Huelva, Spain — with hole EC102 returning 3.9 metres at 3.8% Cu, 0.9% Pb, 1.6% Zn, 2.81 g/t Au, and 71.26 g/t Ag (including 2.6m at 5.5% Cu and 99.15 g/t Ag), while simultaneously confirming that the AAU Exploitation Permit's public consultation phase is now concluded and submitted to the Andalucian Environment Department for formal review. The dual announcement — high-grade VMS copper-gold-silver extension results plus completion of a major permitting milestone — advances Emerita on two fronts simultaneously toward the PFS expected in Q3 2026; IBW hosts three VMS deposits (La Romanera, El Cura, La Infanta) and is widely regarded as one of the highest-grade undeveloped polymetallic projects in Europe.

headline: SILVER X RECORD Q2: 62,252T PROCESSED AT NUEVA RECUPERADA — SILVER +40%, GOLD +55% QoQ AS PLANT HITS FULL CAPACITY (TSXV:AGX)
source_name: Investing News Network / Silver X Mining Corp.
snippet: Silver X Mining (TSXV: AGX) reported July 9 that its Nueva Recuperada plant in Peru processed a record 62,252 tonnes in Q2 2026 — up 39% from 44,883 tonnes in Q1 and up 78% from 34,899 tonnes in Q2 2025 — with silver production rising 40% and gold production up 55% quarter-over-quarter as the facility reached and sustained nominal throughput capacity for the first time, driving H1 combined production toward approximately 463,000 AgEq ounces and placing the company on its declared trajectory to 6 million AgEq ounces annually by 2029. At $59/oz silver and with the production ramp now de-risked at the plant level, Silver X's cash flow profile from Nueva Recuperada is compounding quarter over quarter — a genuine operating leverage story on silver's structural supply deficit in a metal already running its sixth consecutive annual shortfall.

headline: GOLD STRIKE DEPLOYS FIRST DRILL ON FLORIN'S 2.507 MOZ YUKON DEPOSIT — 8,000M+ PROGRAM EYES RESOURCE GROWTH, RESULTS AUGUST (TSXV:GSR)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Gold Strike Resources Corp.
snippet: Gold Strike Resources (TSXV: GSR) announced July 9 that the first of two contracted diamond drill rigs has arrived on site at the Florin Gold Project in Yukon Territory — commencing an 8,000-metre-plus resource-definition and step-out extension program on a deposit hosting 2.507 million ounces of pit-constrained inferred gold at 0.48 g/t Au, with a second rig expected within days and initial assay results anticipated in early August 2026. With Florin's inferred resource delineated across 162.783 million tonnes, this is an open-pit-scale Yukon gold deposit with a catalyst timeline investors can calendar: August assays will either confirm resource upside at the margins or define where the economic shell closes, in a jurisdiction whose tier-1 infrastructure and mineral tenure system have consistently supported project-level financing for comparable deposits.

headline: EQUINOX GOLD Q2: 176,836 OZ, CANADIAN PRODUCTION +11% QoQ — LOS FILOS 20-YEAR COMMUNITY DEALS SIGNED, RESTART ADVANCES (TSX:EQX)
snippet: Equinox Gold (TSX: EQX) reported July 9 Q2 2026 gold production of 176,836 ounces — with its Canadian cornerstone operations (Greenstone and Valentine) delivering 97,273 ounces, an 11% increase quarter-over-quarter — keeping the company on track for 700,000–800,000 oz full-year guidance, while simultaneously disclosing that 20-year land access agreements have been secured with all three communities hosting the suspended Los Filos mine in Guerrero, Mexico, clearing the final social licence obstacle to restart planning. With the July 22 shareholder vote on Equinox's all-share acquisition of Orla Mining now two weeks away, the combination of solid Q2 production, growing Canadian margins, and Los Filos community resolution provides management's strongest operational argument for the share issuance before ballots close.

headline: FORTUNA Q2: 72,217 GEO ACROSS FIVE MINES IN WEST AFRICA AND LATIN AMERICA — ON PACE FOR 281,000-305,000 GEO FULL-YEAR GUIDANCE (NYSE:FSM)
snippet: Fortuna Mining (NYSE: FSM / TSX: FVI) reported July 9 that Q2 2026 gold equivalent production across its five operating mines reached 72,217 GEO — broadly flat with Q1's 72,872 GEO and above the 71,229 GEO in Q2 2025 — with H1 total of 145,089 GEO positioning the company squarely on track for full-year guidance of 281,000–305,000 GEO across Séguéla (Côte d'Ivoire), Yaramoko (Burkina Faso), Mako (Senegal), Caylloma (Peru), and Lindero (Argentina). For retail investors benchmarking mid-tier gold producers, Fortuna's consistent 70K–75K GEO quarterly output through an oil-shock macro year demonstrates multi-mine portfolio resilience — though West Africa's jurisdictional risk concentration (three of five mines) remains the primary discount investors apply to comparable operating metrics versus North American peers.
